chunks: He was asked about a man departing in the first departure before the sun declines, so he said: “No; rather, he may send out his belongings if he wishes, but he himself should not depart until the sun declines.”
And it is narrated: “Whoever does that is among those who ‘hasten in two days.’”

key_terms.تَعَجَّلَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ: hastened departure within two days, echoing the Qur'anic phrasing
key_terms.يَنْفِرُ: departs from Minā during the hajj departure

ai.seo_question: Can a pilgrim leave Minā in the first departure before the sun declines?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning departure from Minā during the first nafr in hajj. It states that a person should not personally leave before the sun declines, though he may send his belongings ahead, and it links such action to the Qur'anic expression about hastening in two days.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
that Imam Abu Abdullah (as) was asked about a man departing during the first departure (nafr al-awwal) before the sun declines.
Imam (as) replied: "No, but he may send off his belongings if he wishes, yet he himself should not leave until the sun has declined."
It is also narrated: "Whoever does so is among those who 'hasten in two days.'"
